limitations: The virtual Apple GPU cannot create the direct Metal 4 queue and residency set. In-flight UBO and MRT pixel A/B used the tracked Metal queue.
The SleepThread counts measure one synthetic guest loop in 250 ms. Device wakeups/s and P-core residency remain unmeasured.
No post-change gameplay window for render passes, load/store bandwidth, evictions, FPS or long frames on A18 Pro.
